decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct versions of the biography for 'General Bryan' (Document 1 and Document 2). Document 1 explicitly states he was born on February 8, 1900, while Document 2 states he was born on July 15, 1905. Both dates are directly asserted in the source text as the birth date for the same named entity. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions to a single winner when sources provide competing assertions, both dates are retained as valid answers derived from the original context.
